Presealed minimum purpose (collector paraphrase): FASTQ 파일에서 count matrix를 생성하는 단계까지 포함한 더 느린 속도의 RNA-seq workflow 안내를 읽는다.

Original context:
This vignette explains the


use of the package and demonstrates typical workflows.


An RNA-seq workflow


on the Bioconductor website covers similar material to this vignette


but at a slower pace, including the generation of count matrices from


FASTQ files.
